description: Dual-Entry JSON drawer of topic-type channel routing and high/low-signal source tiers for deep-research.

tooling.rationale: Engineering/devops tooling requires GitHub star-sorted landscape search and official docs; academic papers rarely add actionable signal.

scientific.rationale: Algorithmic or ML research prioritizes arXiv/Scholar primary papers and reference code implementations.

market.rationale: Market, funding, and product landscape queries prioritize recent news, Wikipedia citation curl fallback, and open-source adoption.

general.rationale: Full 4-channel fan-out with adversarial Phase 2 verification.

high_signal_tiers.rule: Treat primary specifications, official vendor documentation, and verified source repositories as Tier 3 direct primary evidence.
Use Wikipedia curl fallback to extract primary citations when search engines rate-limit; require >=2 independent sources for HIGH confidence.

patterns: SEO content farms & AI-rewritten aggregator blogs
Syndicated press-release reposts counted as multiple sources
Unbenchmarked opinion threads without reproduction steps
high_signal_tiers.rule: Drop syndicated reposts and content farms via R09 DROP_NOISE; three outlets reposting one press release count as a single source.
